mechanism: A separate real tracer consumes SIGKILL terminal notification. The original parent observes WNOWAIT and independently verifies state Z, unchanged birth, zero tracer and retired pinned mm. Recovery is retried before actual parent reaping. Real completed function returns 87654321 before controlled original-register restoration failure.
scope: Native x86-64 mmap recovery with unconsumed original-context restoration
Native i386 mmap recovery with unconsumed original-context restoration
Native x86-64 and i386 completed-function recovery after ECHILD with independently confirmed task death
remaining: Service broker explicit recovery and destruction with another waiter consuming the real terminal notification while the parent retains a zombie
Live PTRACE_EVENT_EXIT stops and other PF_EXITING windows
Nonleader whole-group death with an unreaped leader, preserving real EXEC adoption
Safe ownership and discovery of a surviving old-mm peer after nonleader death
Broader foreign-backend exit/waiter cases and concurrency/scheduler stress
All six compatibility requirements remain incomplete
